question: When was the last time it snowed in england on christmas day?
text:
**December 25, 2021** is the most recent Christmas Day I could verify that snow or sleet fell in England. The Met Office recorded it in the Midlands and also reported snow in the Yorkshire Dales. The UK’s more recent official white Christmas, in **2023**, was recorded in Scotland, not England. ([metoffice.gov.uk](https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/binaries/content/assets/metofficegovuk/pdf/research/library-and-archive/library/publications/factsheets/factsheet_5-white-christmas_2022_2023.pdf))

If you mean **widespread snow already on the ground**, the last Christmas like that was **December 25, 2010**. ([metoffice.gov.uk](https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/about-us/news-and-media/media-centre/weather-and-climate-news/2024/will-it-be-a-white-christmas?utm_source=openai))
